output.reason: The only upstream statement [ev-ab534de2a1e4] is a one-line feature note saying conversion webhooks were added for v1 EC2NodeClass. It does not say what happens to an environment that does nothing, so the proposed claim about "smoother migrations and upgrades" (behavior-change) is not supported by the evidence. The rendered diffs show the storage version moving from v1beta1 to v1 [ev-6216d138f351][ev-b41bd26d4a09], but no evidence links that change to this webhook or to any operator-visible effect, so neither behavior-change nor none can be settled. To decide this, we need the upgrade guide or PR #6400 text stating whether the webhook must be deployed or reachable, and what fails or changes without it.
